fields.value: Directorate of Medical Education and Training, Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow
On the list of in-service (PMHS) candidates provided by the Director General Health Services, Uttar Pradesh

Registration is online only, on upneet.gov.in. Log in with your NEET roll number and the same email ID you used on the NBE portal. Your name, parents' names and date of birth come from NBE and can't be changed. You add your domicile, category, sub-category, in-service (PMHS) status, where you passed MBBS, and your address. Fill the form yourself, not through any agent or third party.
Pay ₹3,000 once. It covers rounds 1, 2 and 3 and is non-refundable.
Pay the deposit tier that matches the colleges you want to choose (₹30,000 / ₹1,00,000 / ₹2,00,000). Without it you cannot fill choices.
MD/MS/Diploma merit includes in-service (PMHS) weightage. DNB and MDS merit uses All-India NEET rank.
Fill as many college + course choices as you want, then lock them. Unlocked choices are not considered for allotment.
Seats are allotted on merit and your locked choices. Results appear on upneet.gov.in.
Download your allotment letter before reporting to the allotted college or nodal centre.
Report with original documents and pay fees at the allotted government college or the designated nodal centre (for private colleges) by the due date.
You must have qualified NEET-PG 2026 (for MD/MS/Diploma/DNB) or NEET-MDS 2026 (for MDS).
Your one-year compulsory rotatory internship must be completed on or before 30th September 2026.
Your one-year compulsory rotatory internship must be completed on or before 31st May 2026.
Graduates of UP government or private medical/dental colleges are eligible for Government State Quota seats and private college seats.
MBBS/BDS from AMU, BHU, AIIMS Raebareli or AIIMS Gorakhpur
Graduates of these institutions are not eligible for Government State Quota seats. They can only apply to private medical and dental colleges.

Candidates who passed MBBS/BDS outside Uttar Pradesh can only apply to private medical and dental colleges. The brochure doesn't say whether this covers degrees from abroad, so FMGs should confirm with DGME UP.
Currently admitted through an earlier NEET-PG/MDS
If you're presently admitted to a course on the basis of an earlier NEET-PG or NEET-MDS, you can't take part until you complete and pass that course.
NEET-qualified in-service PMHS doctors on the DG Health Services list get weightage in the MD/MS/Diploma merit list (not DNB). DNB and MDS merit uses All-India NEET rank, with no weightage.
State quota DNB seats are for in-service only
Only in-service (PMHS) candidates are eligible for state quota DNB seats.
FMGs must meet NBE Information Bulletin 2026 point 4.10: qualified the FMGE screening test, registered with NMC/MCI or a State Medical Council, and internship completed by 30th September 2026.

Foreign nationals must meet NBE Information Bulletin 2026 point 4.11. Your basic medical qualification (equivalent to MBBS) must be recognised by the NMC. If you need MHA security clearance, get it before applying for NEET-PG and submit it with your application. The NMC may grant temporary registration for the course, limited to the college you join, on payment of a fee. For this you must be registered in the country where you got your basic qualification and have an NOC from its medical council to do PG in India. These rules are written for NEET-PG; MDS candidates should confirm with DGME UP.

Reserved category candidates from other states are treated as Unreserved (UR) in UP NEET PG/MDS counselling. The brochure doesn't define "other states"; we go by domicile, so confirm with DGME UP if your domicile and certificate state differ.
PwD certificate from a designated centre

The 5% PwD reservation applies to Government State Quota seats in government medical institutions. To claim it, get a disability certificate (21 benchmark disabilities, RPwD Act 2016, NMC norms) from one of the designated centres in Annexure-2. Certificates from any other hospital or board are not accepted.
During the 3rd round of state quota counselling, and only after candidates of the original category are exhausted.
SC/ST/OBC lists are as notified by the Government of Uttar Pradesh at the time of counselling.
Reservation certificates are valid only in the format prescribed by the Government of Uttar Pradesh and issued by a competent UP authority.
EWS and OBC certificates are valid only if issued on or after 1st April 2026.
PwD certificates from designated centres only
PwD certificates from any other hospital or board are not accepted. See the list of designated disability centres.
Rounds 1, 2 and 3. The stray vacancy round needs a fresh registration and another ₹3,000. No chargeback of the registration fee is entertained.
Deposit eligibility is set by a government order
Check which deposit tier you are eligible for under Govt. Order No. I/1405837/2026 dated 23rd July 2026.
Pay from your own or a family account
Use your own or a family member's bank account for the security fee. Any refund goes back to the same account.
If you don't pay the security fee you cannot fill choices.
Security money refunds for eligible candidates start only after all counselling rounds are complete.
At admission to a private college, you pay the government-fixed tuition fee. Minority institutions charge the tuition fee prescribed by the college.
Download your registration form, registration fee slip and security money receipt after paying.
Log in with your roll number
Fill choices on upneet.gov.in with your NEET roll number and the password you created at registration. Don't share the password.
You can fill as many choices as you want and change them until you lock.
If you don't lock your choices within the scheduled time, you will not be considered for allotment.
Once locked, choices cannot be altered.
Get detailed information about any private college before adding it to your choices.
MD/MS/Diploma merit includes in-service (PMHS) weightage. DNB and MDS merit is based on All-India NEET rank.
Free exit if you don't join
If you are allotted a seat in Round 1 and do not take admission, you can exit with no penalty.
If you took admission after Round 1, you can still participate for an upgrade up to Round 3.
When trying to upgrade, don't fill the seat you already hold. If you are allotted the same seat again, your previous allotment is cancelled.
If you are upgraded and don't take admission in the new seat, the new allotment is cancelled.
Unfilled reserved seats are converted in Round 3, as per the conversion order.
Candidates allotted a seat in UP counselling who did not join or who resigned cannot take part in the stray vacancy round.
Anyone admitted to a PG course anywhere in India through AIQ or another state's quota cannot take part in the UP stray vacancy round.
Fresh registration with ₹3,000 is mandatory. Only these candidates are on the stray vacancy merit list.
If you are allotted a seat in the stray round and don't report and join, you lose your security deposit and are debarred from UP NEET PG/MDS counselling 2027.
Complete admission and pay fees at the allotted government college, or at the nodal centre named in your allotment letter for private colleges.
Miss the deadline, lose the seat
If you don't take admission by the due date, you forfeit the seat.
If you fail to produce originals, or if concealment or falsification is found at admission or later during the course, you lose your candidature and will face legal action.
Only admitted candidates can resign, in person, at the college or nodal centre where they took admission. Resignations sent any other way are not valid.
Must be updated on the portal
The college or nodal centre updates your resignation on the NIC portal within the scheduled time. Only portal-updated resignations count.
Miss a deadline and the next tier's penalty applies

Each resignation window closes 2 days before the next round's choice filling. If you resign after it closes, the next stage's rules apply. For example, a Round 1 admittee who resigns late loses the full security deposit.
If you leave a government medical or dental college seat after the final round and before completing the course, you are debarred from the next academic session's admission process.
Your certificates are held until the bond is served

Your course certificates stay with the institution until you complete 2 years of government service or pay the bond amount. The government also has a first lien on the certificates you submitted at admission, and the institution may keep them until the lien is cleared.
Bond is released if no posting comes
If the government does not offer you a posting within 3 months of finishing the course, the bond is released.
If you don't pay the bond amount in time, interest applies and it can be recovered as arrears of land revenue. You also bear the stamp duty on the bond.
Stipend repayment for employed candidates on study leave

If you're employed and the government grants you stipend for 24 months to study, but you work less than 24 months during the course, the proportionate amount is treated as stipend. You then pay back the balance stipend to the government, on top of the security amount. The bond form leaves the amounts blank, so confirm with DGME UP whether this applies to you.
If you don't serve, pay immediately

If you don't serve 2 years, you must pay the bond amount immediately into the specified Government Treasury. During the 2 years of service you are paid a stipend. The bond is governed by the Laws of India.

Family's total annual income below ₹8 lakh in the stated financial year. The family must not own any of: 5 acres or more of agricultural land; a flat of 1,000 sq ft or more; a residential plot of 100 sq yd or more in a notified municipality; or 200 sq yd or more outside one. You must be a permanent resident and not belong to a caste notified as SC, ST or OBC. Valid for the financial year stated on it. Uses the Prapatra-1 format (office memo dated 14th March 2019) with your attested passport-size photo and full address (village, post office, police station, tehsil, district, state, PIN). Issued by the District Magistrate, Additional District Magistrate, City Magistrate, Pargana Magistrate or Tehsildar.
Disability certificate from a designated centre (Annexure-2)

Required if you take admission in a government medical or dental college. The brochure also says everyone admitted to PG courses signs a bond, so confirm with DGME if you're joining a private college. You bear the stamp duty. The bond form asks for your Aadhaar number, mobile, email, and permanent and temporary addresses.
One set of self-attested photocopies of everything
Bring originals plus one self-attested photocopy set.
Up to 2 days before Round 2 choice filling starts (e.g. by 11:00 AM on 22nd July 2026 if choice filling opens 11:00 AM on 24th July 2026)
Free exit. Government colleges refund all fees except the admission fee. Private colleges refund tuition paid.

If your deposit was already refunded you must pay it back, by demand draft in favour of the DG, Medical Education & Training, UP, Lucknow.
Candidates in government medical or dental colleges must serve it; the brochure also says everyone admitted to PG courses signs a bond, so private-college candidates should confirm with DGME

Service must be in Uttar Pradesh, as far as possible / as required outside metros: as a Senior Resident or contractual lecturer in a government medical college, or as a contractual specialist at a district hospital or community health centre run under the Medical & Health Department.
Email only the official address, with your name, registration no., roll no., All India Rank, contact no. and email ID. Emails without these may not be answered.
Queries already answered in the information bulletin will not be answered.
Court cases about counselling fall under Lucknow jurisdiction only.
Check dgme.up.gov.in and upneet.gov.in for the latest updates.
